story.title: Made to a standard
paras: Most things on a desk are made to hit a price. We would rather make one thing well: a single mechanical key, built like the keyboards people spend hundreds on, and small enough to carry.
Every OneKey uses a real hot-swap switch, a real keycap, and materials chosen for how they sound and feel. Click it while you think. Carry it as a reminder of what a well-made object feels like.
OneKey is the first of many Key Bored desk objects.

products.name: OneKey Solid
products.tagline: One piece. One key. Pure click.
products.blurb: Carved from a single piece of colored polycarbonate. The switch clicks straight into the body, with an open chamber underneath for a clean, crisp sound. A cream keycap is included.
points: One solid body, nothing to loosen

products.name: OneKey Screw-in
products.tagline: A metal heart in a color shell.
products.blurb: A machined metal holster becomes the switch plate and the weight, screwed into brass inserts molded into the shell. Heavier, deeper, and serviceable for life. A cream keycap is included.
points: Air chamber tuned under the switch
Replaceable shell, the metal lasts forever

products.name: OneKey Nested
products.blurb: A one-piece brass weight slides up into an anodized aluminum case, held by four Torx screws. The seam hides under a 0.4 mm shoulder, so it reads as one object. A cream keycap is included.
points: Torx hardware, no threads in aluminum
Brass across most of the underside

products.name: OneKey Stack
products.tagline: A brass core you can see.
products.blurb: A full-width brass core with an aluminum sleeve dropped over it. The brass band shows along the bottom edge: the heaviest OneKey we make. A cream keycap is included.

products.name: OneKey 75
products.tagline: The whole keyboard, built the same way.
products.blurb: One block of aluminum with a holster machined for every key, the circuit board right under the metal walls, and a brass base. No foam, no gaskets. Just heavy metal.
points: A machined holster for every switch

preorder.note: Every OneKey is made to order. Production starts after the pre-order window closes.
